'Production wiring' says 'yielding 0.19% mean error and 0.30% maximum error across the published Z = 1..10 table' and names computations/rho-k-graded-atomic-mass.witness.json; that witness records mean_abs_err_pct = 0.310122 and max_abs_err_pct = 0.413107 (its own assertions single_gen_mean_abs_err_pct and single_gen_max_abs_err_pct carry the same values, passing only because the tolerances are 0.5 and 1.0). The quoted MAX (0.30%) is below the witness's MEAN (0.31%). The separate headline figure '0.18% mean / 0.35% max across Z = 1..20' cites a different witness (atomic-braid-mass-paper-formula.witness.json) and is not adjudicated here. (3) VERIFIED CORRECT, do not re-flag: alpha = m_e * 8G = 0.51099895069 * 7.327724753 = 3.744460 MeV, matching the quoted 3.7445; the convention-D declaration z = q^3/(q^2+1) is CORRECT and explicitly labelled, which is the hygiene per-block-hopf-jones-absorption-pattern.md lacks; the Markov multiplicativity statement and the LO rearrangement are algebraically sound; all three named producer/witness files exist.
